_comment: Synthetic example of an overrides file. Copy the shape, not the content.
Keys under 'contacts' are row keys: the contact_id column if your list has one,
else row<N> by zero-based input order.
The point of this file is that every human judgement call is written down with a
reason, so it stays reviewable. Never hand-edit a grade in the CSV instead.

ok_rebrand.note: the company was renamed; the row is correct as filed

contacts.row12: Northgate Street Capital rebranded to Parkway Capital in 2024 — same firm, same person

dual_role.note: legitimately holds two roles, so the employer mismatch is expected

contacts.row31: listed at both the fund and its operating arm; the fund seat is the right one for this campaign

wrong_arm.note: sits in a different arm of the same brand than the one we target

contacts.row58: profile shows the public-markets arm, not the buyout arm

left_company.note: no longer at the company we filed them under

contacts.row40: profile shows they moved to an operating role at a portfolio company in 2025

unverifiable.note: no profile data available, so the automated grade is unconfirmed — treat with caution

contacts.row77: profile scrape returned empty; grade is from the title alone
